description: Transvaalbuurt 1908-1914 speculative rows, low-ground variant (Retiefstraat 45-75, Pretoriusstraat 72-120): 5-7 m dark red-brown brick fronts of a 3.35 m ground storey and three 3.15 m upper storeys under a light simple cornice at about 13.4 m (five bouwlagen with the attic); three axes of white-framed windows with a top light, the centre axis a balcony door with an iron-railed projecting balcony on storeys 1-3; over the cornice a pointed brick gable, a brick wall dormer over the centre axis, or a white pointed timber dormer, on a pitched tile roof. Its twin transvaal-1911-five-storey-tall has the 4.0 m ground storey of Transvaalstraat 3-47 and Retiefstraat 3-41; the photo decides between them (auto-place --photo-decides)

match.note: Cornice line 12.8-14.3 m on the strips (Retiefstraat 45-75 12.8, Pretoriusstraat 72-120 13.4, Transvaalstraat 3-47 14.0-14.3), gable and dormer tops 15.5-16.7 m. The strip skyline is no guide on these rows: it reads the dormer, gable and chimney tops or the street trees at 15.5-18.4 m (Retiefstraat 3-75, Transvaalstraat 25-45), so the eaves criterion is 3DBAG: 12-16.6 m on the family (the gables on some pands, 15.5-16.2 m on Retiefstraat 47-67 and Transvaalstraat 7-19) at the type pitch of 4 storeys, and 3DBAG bouwlagen 5 (234 of 276 pands; the attic counts). 3DBAG roof rise reads 0-0.1 m (flat) over the pitched tile roofs: no roof criterion. BAG 1908-1914 on all 37 photographed faces. The 8.5 m Retiefstraat 3-41 fronts keep three wide axes. No balcony veto (the type has them). Crown by the skyline: a narrow-topped tall crown is a pointed gable (Retiefstraat 45-75, Pretoriusstraat 72-120), a 1-2.8 m flat top a brick wall dormer (Retiefstraat 3-41, 45-51), a small low crown a white timber dormer (Transvaalstraat 3-47, Majubastraat 1-151). Two variants of one design that facts cannot tell apart (3DBAG eaves and bouwlagen agree): this one has the low 3.35 m ground storey (window heads 5.7-6.0, 8.9-9.2, 11.9-12.5 m, cornice 13.3-13.5 m), transvaal-1911-five-storey-tall the 4.0 m one (heads 6.7, 9.9-10.0, 13.1-13.5 m, cornice 14.2-15.0 m); run auto-place with --photo-decides

notes: Round 3 (#152, 2026-11-01): match.crownFromType none. The 2023-01-02 strips have bare branches over every front (skyline eaves 15.5-18.4 m over a 13 m cornice), so a skyline that is unread, fits no crown, stands over the pand's 3DBAG roof max or hugs one party wall gives the cornice crown, not the first variant (the point gable drawn on Smitstraat 36-38, Transvaalstraat 54-56 and Laing's Nekstraat 36-38). A real gable or wall dormer under a polluted sky is a reviewer crown pin (transvaalbuurt-oost-review-crowns.json). roof.rakeClear: the saddle under the point gable stays 4 cm square under its rakes (GLB audit zfight-tight).
Palette: the type default is a mid dark red-brown; every placed pand takes its trim-normalised strip wall (auto-place measuredPalette).

Retiefstraat 45-75 sheet (2026-10-31): every window has a white stone lintel block and sill (windowSurround stone-lintel); the roof face behind the cornice is orange-red tile (Retiefstraat 45-75, Transvaalstraat 74-104)

Pretoriusstraat 71-95 and 72-120 sheets (2026-10-31): the 6.8-7.1 m fronts carry four axes, the balcony on the second from the door side; strip storey heights (measureFacade storeyM) read 2.9-3.1 m on Retiefstraat 45-75, 3.1-3.3 m on Transvaalstraat 3-47 and Retiefstraat 3-41, 3.2-3.5 m on Pretoriusstraat: they do not separate the low- and tall-ground twins (the ground storey does), so the photo decides
